name: make-shorts
title: Make short clips
template:
Find the {{count}} strongest short clips in this project and cut each one as its own branch of the timeline.

For each clip: pick a self-contained moment with a clear hook in its first seconds, a payoff, and a natural end. Keep every clip under sixty seconds, trim dead air at both ends, and say in one sentence why it works.

Work on your own branch, leave the source material untouched, and finish with a short list of the clips, their start and end times and your reasons, best first.
